$comment: FHWA Scheme F classes 1-3. Light vehicles. Included for completeness of the classification; pavement damage from these classes is negligible relative to classes 5-13.

load.basis: Approximately 45 % of a 250 kg (rider + machine) touring motorcycle mass, a representative front-axle share. Order-of-magnitude only.

axles.source: Representative large touring motorcycle. Wheelbase 1450 mm is typical of the class. Single wheel on the vehicle centreline, so track width is zero by definition. Confidence: low — representative geometry, not a specific model.

load.basis: Approximately 55 % of a 250 kg (rider + machine) touring motorcycle mass. Order-of-magnitude only.

axles.source: Representative large touring motorcycle; wheelbase 1450 mm from axle 1. Confidence: low — representative geometry, not a specific model.

gvw.basis: Representative kerb mass plus rider for a large touring motorcycle.

units.notes: Included so the FHWA classification is complete. Contact-patch and dimension tools work, but loads are representative rather than regulatory.

sources.title: Traffic Monitoring Guide, Scheme F class 1

load.basis: Approximately 55 % of a 1630 kg mid-size sedan kerb mass on the front axle (front-engine, front-drive weight split).

axles.source: Representative mid-size sedan. Wheelbase 2790 mm and track 1560 mm are typical of the segment. Confidence: low — representative geometry, not a specific model.

load.basis: Approximately 45 % of a 1630 kg mid-size sedan kerb mass on the rear axle.

axles.source: Representative mid-size sedan; wheelbase 2790 mm from axle 1. Confidence: low — representative geometry, not a specific model.

gvw.basis: Representative kerb mass of a mid-size passenger sedan.

units.notes: FHWA class 2 also covers cars pulling one- and two-axle trailers; only the base two-axle car is modelled.

sources.title: Traffic Monitoring Guide, Scheme F class 2

load.basis: Approximately 57 % of a 2800 kg crew-cab half-ton pickup kerb mass on the front axle.

axles.source: Representative crew-cab half-ton pickup. Wheelbase 3680 mm and track 1730 mm are typical of the segment. Confidence: low — representative geometry, not a specific model.

load.basis: Approximately 43 % of a 2800 kg crew-cab half-ton pickup kerb mass on the rear axle, unladen.

axles.source: Representative crew-cab half-ton pickup; wheelbase 3680 mm from axle 1. Confidence: low — representative geometry, not a specific model.

gvw.basis: Representative kerb mass of a crew-cab half-ton pickup.

units.notes: Class 3 is defined by four tires on two axles, which distinguishes it from class 5 (six tires, dual rear).

sources.title: Traffic Monitoring Guide, Scheme F class 3
